verdict.rationale: Gmail documents delegation: one or more delegates can read, send, and delete mail in another user's account. That lets a team work one shared mailbox and see the same messages. Beyond that single mechanism, the evidence shows no purpose-built shared-inbox or team-channel features. Missing for 10: a dedicated collaborative or group inbox, team visibility of conversation state such as who replied or claimed a thread, assignment or internal notes, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-user delegation.
